data.description:
Goal:
Replace whole-replica event scanning with a durable, locally authored outbox and credential-scoped inbox publication.

Verification:
1. Run focused replication/outbox crash, retry, rotation, and released-client compatibility tests.
2. Run a two-clone temporary-remote test and confirm neither clone republishes acknowledged compacted history.
3. Run make sanity.

Constraints:
Persist local work before cache mutation. Register each writer epoch through control CAS. Never derive an outbox by scanning replicated event, index, snapshot, archive, or pack trees.
